{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
sales = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Check for the 6 QA orders with revenue 999999.99
qa_orders = sales[sales['revenue'] == 999999.99]
print(f'Number of QA orders: {len(qa_orders)}')

# Drop them
sales_clean = sales[~sales['revenue'].isin([999999.99])]

# Verify
len(sales_clean), sales_clean['revenue'].max()"}
